shots.prompt: An original warm painterly children's forest adventure, soft illustrated textures, expressive rounded creatures, mossy green and warm amber with slate-blue shadows. Match the supplied references exactly. Reference 1 is a character sheet: use exactly ONE of each of its three characters, not their repeated studies: Nevet the green leaf-eared sprout, Adva the slate-blue scalloped cheek-fin creature, Zohar the ochre round-eared creature with exactly three belly lights. Reference 2 establishes the olive frog-like river resident and woodland atmosphere ONLY: in this opening the woven basket must be EMPTY, with no apples or flask. Four creatures total, no humans. All communication is gestures, animal chirps and instrumental notes, absolutely no intelligible words, dialogue, narration, singing lyrics, lettering or subtitles. Gentle, safe, curious mood, no menace. One continuous shot, no montage. Do not render a character sheet. Medium-wide eye-level shot at a quiet mossy stream. The small olive river resident on the right lifts an EMPTY wicker basket toward Nevet, Adva and Zohar together on the left. It tilts the basket so its empty interior is visible, then makes a hopeful open-paw gesture. The three friends exchange curious glances and lean slightly toward it, wanting to understand. Keep basket and paws separate and anatomically stable. Soft running water, one questioning animal chirp, a warm wordless answering hum. Hold the final curious pose.
